info.title: Libraries Global Team API
info.description: Read-only search and retrieval of published public Library records. Requires an API key belonging to an API account (an organisation or individual) with settled paid coverage. Keys grant no user session, Staff access or protected data. Only English content is currently live. The £100 monthly offer includes, per paid billing period, 10,000 successful requests, 262,144,000 bytes (250 MiB) of uncompressed JSON and 100 analysis credits, pooled across every key, with 30 attempts per minute, two concurrent requests, 128 KiB per response and 50 records per page. The billing period is the settled Stripe subscription period [start, end); a new allowance opens only once the next period is paid. Purchase-time limits take precedence. Successful responses, including repeated reads, consume allowance; failed, refused and timed-out requests do not. Overage is off unless an organiser opts in with a monthly cap before tax (1p per extra request, 10p per extra MiB measured from total excess bytes, 50p per extra analysis credit). Requests that would cross an exhausted allowance or the cap are refused with 429. Availability and purchasing restrictions are described in the current Knowledge access guide. Browser beta and Basic Auth cookies are unnecessary for the machine routes; discovery files and website pages retain their beta and staging gates. Other website APIs and proposed resources are outside this contract. Preserve attribution and source-specific licences; missing data does not prove a service is unavailable. Infrastructure or access-gate failures can return non-JSON responses. Version 2.1 adds staged service, submission and analysis resources. Each is marked x-feature-flag and is switched on by the operator in stages; while its flag is off a route answers 404 resource_not_enabled before any key or accounting work. A flag never bypasses authentication, scopes, limits or accounting.

post.summary: Summarise a published service or place
post.description: Requires analysis:run. Synchronous counted aggregates over published records; returns the completed result with its job. Credits are reserved at acceptance under the account's ledger lock, settled once when a result completes and refunded on failure, cancellation or expiry. A cached identical result spends no credit; the request and response bytes are still metered. Retries with identical input reuse the open job, so a replay cannot start a second charged job. The worst-case credits must be available (or fit the overage cap) to start a job. Identical input within 15 minutes returns the stored result.

post.summary: Start or reuse a Reach analysis
post.description: Requires analysis:run. Returns 202 with a job to poll, or 200 with a cached or finished result. Uses the CMS and native analysis admission, canonical service membership and dataset coverage. At most five open jobs per account; jobs expire after 30 minutes. Credits are reserved at acceptance under the account's ledger lock, settled once when a result completes and refunded on failure, cancellation or expiry. A cached identical result spends no credit; the request and response bytes are still metered. Retries with identical input reuse the open job, so a replay cannot start a second charged job. The worst-case credits must be available (or fit the overage cap) to start a job. Results below 128 KiB; geometry is omitted (geometry: unavailable) when it would be large.

TeamApiKey.description: API key, not a user JWT or CMS token. Send Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY. Scopes: search:read (search), libraries:read (records and places), services:read (services), submissions:write (proposals and their status), analysis:run (summary, Reach and jobs). New keys default to the read scopes; submissions:write and analysis:run need explicit confirmation at creation. A key authenticates software for an API account, never a person or staff member. Keep keys on your server.

Locale.name: locale
Locale.description: Content locale. Only English is currently live.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum records per page. Reduce this if the response exceeds the byte cap.

Country.name: country
Country.description: Country slug, not a display name or ISO code.

After.name: after
After.description: Opaque meta.nextCursor from the preceding page. Keep locale and country unchanged; stop when nextCursor is null.

EntityRef.name: entityRef
EntityRef.description: Exact entityRef from search or list results, URL-encoded as one path segment. Not a documentId or page URL. References can change after a rename or geographic move.

Region.name: region
Region.description: Region slug from GET /api/v1/places/{country}. Requires country.

Area.name: area
Area.description: Area slug from GET /api/v1/places/{country}/{region}. Requires region.

RegionPath.name: region
RegionPath.description: Region slug from GET /api/v1/places/{country}; unique within its country.

AreaPath.name: area
AreaPath.description: Area slug from GET /api/v1/places/{country}/{region}; unique within its region.

ServiceRef.name: ref
ServiceRef.description: A service's stable ref from GET /api/v1/services. Refs do not change when a service is renamed; slugs can.

JobId.name: id
JobId.description: Job id from an analysis response.

ProposalId.name: id
ProposalId.description: Proposal id from a submissions response.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required client key, unique per proposal. A retry with the same key and payload returns the original proposal (meta.replayed true) without filing another.

SearchRequest.description: Filters combine with AND. Unknown properties are rejected; raw search-engine filters and sorting are unavailable. Body limit: 8192 bytes.

locale.description: Only live content locales are accepted.

libraryType.description: Exact indexed Library type value; take values from returned records.

operationalStatus.description: Exact indexed operational value, for example open or appointment_only. This is not date-specific opening availability.

area.description: Area slug; requires region, which requires country.

SearchHit.description: Search summary; fields absent from the index may be omitted. Retrieve the full Library record for its source credits.

estimatedTotal.description: Search estimate, not a guaranteed complete catalogue count.

LibraryRecord.description: Explicit public record projection. Null means information is not recorded. These routes do not include opening times, facility relations, Events, verification dates or every field shown on the website.

documentId.description: Strapi document identifier; not accepted by the entityRef detail route.

location.description: Stored coordinates; older records may contain numeric strings.

updatedAt.description: Record modification time, not a verification date.

fields.description: Source field associations as stored JSON, or null when unspecified.

DatasetCredit.description: Source-specific credits. A missing credit or unconfirmed licence does not establish redistribution permission. API access does not replace source terms.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next list page, or null at the end and for a detail response.

attribution.description: Retain alongside the relevant sourceRecords credits.

iso2.description: Countries only: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (ISO 3166-2 for the UK's nations).

ServiceType.description: library_service: a library authority or service operating its member libraries. university_system: academic libraries of one university or system. consortium: a cooperative of independently run libraries. Not every service is a public-library service.

semantics.description: What serviceType and membership mean. Membership is not staff authority and does not imply public access or a shared catalogue.

ProposalFields.description: Whitelisted fields only. Any other field (relations, slugs, entityRef, source records, staff, verification or media fields) or a dotted path is refused with field_not_allowed or field_path_refused. lat and lng go together. Values cannot be empty.

licence.description: Licence of the source the proposal is based on; recorded with the proposal for review.

library.description: ProposalFields plus libraryType (an existing Library type name).

changes.description: Field-scoped proposed values. The live values are recorded with the proposal so moderators can review conflicts.

status.description: Safe status only: reviewer notes and identities are never returned.

result.description: The published Library after acceptance, once it is public.

cached.description: True when an identical result already existed; no credit was spent.

expiresAt.description: A pending job not completed by then expires and its credits are refunded.

operation.description: service.profile and place.profile (1 credit): library counts by operational status and Library type. service.coverage and place.coverage (5 credits, richer joins): the profile plus completeness (website, opening hours, contact, location, catalogue), records verified within 365 days and per-Dataset source and licence counts.

mode.description: library (5 credits): one published Library by entityRef. service (20 credits): one reporting area (areaCode) of a published service. network (40 credits): the whole service across its reporting areas; only when API_NETWORK_REACH_ENABLED is on, else 404 analysis_mode_unavailable.

ref.description: Library entityRef (library mode) or service ref.

minutes.description: Optional single travel-time band. Library mode returns all four bands when omitted.

areaCode.description: Reporting area; service mode only and required there.

ReachRequest.description: Inputs are published references and enumerated options only. Polygons, coordinates, client-chosen memberships, upstream URLs and batches are not accepted.

BadRequest.description: Invalid input or unavailable content locale. Correct the request before retrying.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, expired, revoked or regenerated key. Obtain a valid key before retrying.

Forbidden.description: The key lacks the required scope, or the API account's paid coverage or organisation is inactive.

NotFound.description: No published record resolves for this reference, the resource's flag is off (resource_not_enabled), or the job or proposal is not this account's. Unknown, private and foreign references get the same answer.

RateLimited.description: Refused before any work. quota_requests, quota_bytes and quota_analysis: an included allowance is used up and overage is off. overage_cap: the work would cross the organiser's overage cap. rate_limit: more than 30 attempts a minute. concurrency_limit: two requests already in flight. Respect Retry-After. Analysis also uses analysis_queue_full (five open jobs per account) and analysis_capacity (native capacity); submissions use proposal_rate_limit (30 proposals an hour per key, 200 a day per account).

X-API-Quota-Reset.description: End of the current paid billing period, present for quota and overage-cap refusals.

UpstreamUnavailable.description: Upstream failure or oversized response. Retry with backoff; reduce the page size for oversized responses.

ServiceUnavailable.description: API configuration, Team service, search, records or accounting is temporarily unavailable. Retry with backoff.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with existing work. idempotency_conflict: the Idempotency-Key was used with a different payload. duplicate_proposal: this account already has the same proposal open (error.proposalId). possible_duplicate: a published Library already matches (error.existing lists entityRefs; propose a correction instead). no_change: the correction matches the live values. job_not_complete, job_failed: the job has no result yet or failed. analysis_in_progress: an identical summary is running.

Gone.description: The job's result has expired and was deleted (job_result_expired). Results are kept 24 hours for Reach and 15 minutes for summaries.

AnalysisUnavailable.description: The analysis cannot be produced for this reference (for example no routing or population coverage, an unroutable or unmapped Library). The reserved credits were refunded. error.job describes the closed job.
